config:
title = loom benchmark [r0-ghostty]
font-family = Menlo
font-size = 10
font-feature = -liga
font-feature = -calt
window-width = 100
window-height = 30
window-padding-x = 0
window-padding-y = 0
window-save-state = never
window-inherit-working-directory = false

cursor-style-blink = false
scrollback-limit = 10000000
shell-integration = none
quit-after-last-window-closed = true
background-opacity = 1
macos-titlebar-style = native

visibility_confirmation.method: CLI auto-foreground per explicit user request; not independently verified by CUA
